question: Should OpenClaw accept the opt-in `includeFamily` contract that exposes bounded reset-family transcript history through `chat.history` and `sessions_history`, while rejecting `includeFamily` with `offset`?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a narrow code repair; it is a model-facing archived-history visibility and public API decision that affects session-state and security boundaries.

options.title: Accept `includeFamily` as proposed
options.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms the bounded/header-checked archive exposure, ordering, docs, and generated clients are the desired contract.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the author to reduce the public/model-facing surface, add metadata-only discovery first, or restrict archive inclusion further before accepting the API.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want archived reset-family history exposed through the history tool surface.

recommendation.title: Accept `includeFamily` as proposed
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms the bounded/header-checked archive exposure, ordering, docs, and generated clients are the desired contract.

likelyOwner.reason: `jalehman` has recent transcript-reader seam ownership signals and review history on scheduled reset archive behavior, making them the best available owner for this API/security-boundary choice.
